checks.name: Unapproved package makes no schema/Storage changes
Approved package executes and creates a private article-only bucket
Focused read-only deployment postflight returns booleans without private payloads
Public feed counts ALL 126 published eligible events with no report data or hidden 100-row ceiling
Legacy map DTO retained while private report coordinates are replaced by curated event coordinates
Official region prefix, type, status, search, sort and page validation work
Events without coordinates remain in list; multiple locations/reports do not duplicate event rows
Only event managers can link verified reports; direct private SELECT remains denied
Multiple verified reports link to one event, idempotently, with audit and no implicit publication/coordinate copy
Event status updates are visible through the shared map/list feed
Unpublication removes an event from both shared feed and map contract; child change touches timestamp
Media registration is role/version bounded and creates a unique safe path without public access
Commit attaches only registered uploaded objects; draft remains private; stale write cannot overwrite
Published CURRENT cover visible anonymously; archive revokes new reads without deleting originals
Aborted pre-upload reservations can be cleaned without deleting article or current media
New bucket blocks direct client uploads/deletes even alongside a broad legacy Storage policy
Public roles cannot edit articles or disaster events
No public writes to media registry or RPCs; cleanup candidates never delete business rows
